label: Dot logo (assemble / collapse)
description: A logo MARK made of dots in a ring that assembles out of a point, types its wordmark in letter by letter, and can then collapse back into ONE dot that travels on (move) to become the next thing -- the Cosmos handoff: an image swarm collapses to a point, the mark appears there; later the mark collapses to a dot that swells into a search bar or a button placed where it lands. Full-frame; the mark sits at x/y. Pair a swarm 'point' formation at the same spot and time for the handoff in. Example: {"wordmark":"COSMOS","tagline":"Your space for inspiration","at":0.2,"collapse_at":2.4,"move":{"x":0.5,"y":0.62,"scale":1.6}}.

x.label: Mark centre, fraction of the frame width (default 0.5)

y.label: Mark centre, fraction of the frame height (default 0.42)

dot_size.label: Dot diameter as a fraction of the frame width (default 0.017)

radius.label: Ring radius as a fraction of the frame width (default 0.021)

spin.label: Degrees the ring turns as it assembles (default 90)

at.label: When the dots start to assemble (s, default 0.2)

wordmark.label: The name under the mark (letters rise in)

word_size.label: Wordmark size as a fraction of the frame width (default 0.019)

collapse_at.label: When the words leave and the ring pulls into one dot (omit to hold)

merged_scale.label: Size of the merged dot relative to one dot (default 1.25)

move.label: After the collapse: {at?, x, y (0-1), scale?, color?, duration?, hold?, fade? (default true: it hands off where it lands)}
